description: #1104: the gates that hold an agent's record create and/or update for a person's approval, instead of applying it. Each has the agent_id (an Agents-database record), operations (create, update), database_id (null = every database), fields (null = any write; otherwise only a write that touches one of those api_names) and enabled.
